official_measurement_examples.name: Official-search fee
official_measurement_examples.fact: HM Land Registry's current service offers a free personal search and a £15 official search certificate.

official_measurement_examples.name: Migration status
official_measurement_examples.fact: The Local Land Charges Programme was updated 20 July 2026 and continues phased migration of local authority registers to HM Land Registry.

official_measurement_examples.name: Registered-charge caveat
official_measurement_examples.fact: HM Land Registry states land may remain subject to a local land charge even if the charge has not been registered.

official_measurement_examples.name: CON29 separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: HM Land Registry states local authorities continue to answer CON29 enquiries such as nearby road schemes and outstanding notices after Local Land Charges migration.

official_measurement_examples.name: Official versus personal search
official_measurement_examples.fact: Practice Guide 79 distinguishes an official search from a personal search and gives additional official-search information and protection.

official_measurement_examples.name: Search-time snapshot
official_measurement_examples.fact: The service terms say a search shows charges in the searched place at a particular time and cannot show a charge being added while the search is taking place.

official_measurement_examples.name: Current search-results update
official_measurement_examples.fact: HM Land Registry local-land-charge search-results guidance was updated 22 July 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: Register scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: Local land charges can include planning conditions, highways agreements, tree preservation orders, conservation areas, listed buildings and environmental health notices.

core_rules: local land charge is not planning refusal
local land charge is not planning permission
absence of a registered charge is not proof no obligation exists
personal search is not an official search certificate
official search certificate is not planning permission
CON29 enquiry is distinct from Local Land Charges register search
CON29 result is not planning permission
LLC migration to HMLR is not cancellation of existing charges
local authority transfer date is not charge creation date
register search is a time-specific snapshot not a future guarantee
charge registration date is not the date the underlying obligation necessarily arose
originating authority is not necessarily the planning decision-maker
planning condition charge must be read with the actual planning decision
planning condition existence is not proof it remains outstanding
highways agreement charge is not proof highway works are incomplete
tree preservation order charge is not proof tree works are impossible
conservation area charge is not planning refusal
listed-building charge is not listed-building consent outcome
environmental-health notice is distinct from planning enforcement
financial charge requires its own underlying details
Light Obstruction Notice is not a planning permission
search map geometry is not a Land Registry title boundary
LLC search area is not ownership extent
title number search input is not proof every charge is title-wide
INSPIRE ID search input is not legal boundary determination
official search fee is not a development fee
free personal search does not provide the same evidential protection as an official search
repeat-search availability does not guarantee no new charge after the repeat search
six-month repeat-search facility is not a six-month planning clearance
service availability is not data completeness for non-migrated authorities
non-migrated authority area requires the relevant local authority route
HMLR search result is not a substitute for CON29 where CON29 information is needed
LLC register is not a complete planning history
LLC register is not a complete building-control history
LLC register is not a complete environmental-permit history
registered covenant information is distinct from Local Land Charges
private easement is distinct from Local Land Charges
public right of way status is distinct from Local Land Charges
charge cancellation application is not cancellation completed
charge variation application is not variation completed
search-result clarification must use the originating or relevant authority evidence
one-off search error correction is not evidence the underlying charge never existed
local authority gold status is a service-quality marker not parcel accuracy certification
migration timetable is not parcel search certainty
source and search dates must be preserved
NO_DATA must remain NO_DATA rather than no local land charge
no parcel legal-clearance planning outcome or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
research confidence is not parcel Local Land Charges accuracy
